title: Runic Storage
summary: Connect storage units to a terminal and search all their items from one inventory. Add more units or upgrade the ones you have, from 40 slots each up to 360.
description:
Connect storage units to a terminal and search their items from one inventory. Filter by category, sort stacks, quick-stack matching items from your bag, or use the stored materials at nearby crafting stations. The terminal has no crafting menu of its own.

At a workbench's wooden tier, find the Storage Workbench under Base (20 wood). Use it to make a Storage Terminal (10 copper bars + 20 wood) and Copper Storage Units (30 copper bars each). Place them edge-to-edge and press E on the terminal or a connected unit. Gaps and diagonals don't connect. Units need a connected terminal, and access is local.

Copper units hold 40 slots. Craft an upgrade gem, select it in your hotbar, and press E on a unit without emptying it first. Each gem costs 40 bars of its material and adds 40 slots. Follow every tier in order: Copper 40, Tin 80, Iron 120, Scarlet 160, Octarine 200, Galaxite 240, Solarite 280, Pandorium 320, Relucite 360.

Mining a unit moves its items into available space in units still connected to the terminal; anything that doesn't fit drops with the unit. Isolated units drop all their contents. Upgraded units keep their tier. Breaking a connection leaves the disconnected units' contents intact; reconnect them to regain access.

Install Runic Storage and CoreLib on the host and every joining player. Mouse and keyboard interface, with English labels. Currently in testing; multiplayer has not yet been verified. Empty your storage before uninstalling.

Uses UI components adapted from moorowl's Item Browser under the MIT license; no separate Item Browser installation needed.
